spans.s:
mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Eaten, eating, (either that which is eaten, or the person who has eaten.)
2 Possessed, enjoyed.
n. (-क्तं)
Food.
E.
भुज to eat, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Having eaten.
2 Having possessed.
E.
भुज to eat, क्तवतु aff.

n. (-षं)
Orts, leavings.
E.
भुक्त, and शेष remainder.

n. (-तं)
Orts, leavings, either after a meal or what has dropped from the mouth.
E.
भुक्त eaten, समुज्झित abandoned.

Possession, fruition, usufruct.
E.
भुज to eat, aff. क्तिन्.

ind.
Having possessed, eaten, enjoyed, &c.
E.
भुज to eat, क्त्वा aff.

Darkness.
E.
भू to be, Uṇādi aff. कक्.

m. (-म्बः)
A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen.)
E.
भू the earth, and कदम्ब nauclea.

m. (-म्पः)
An earth-quake.
E.
भू the earth, and कम्प a trembling.

m. (-र्णः)
(In astronomy), The radius of the equator.
E.
भू, and कर्ण a sine.

m. (-पः)
A name of VASUDEVA, the father of KṚṢṆA.
E.
भू the earth, and कश्यप KAŚYAPA; being an incarnation of that personage.

m. (-कः)
A small kind of heron.
E.
भू earth, and काक a crow.

m. (-शः)
1 An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.)
2 The Indian fig.
f. (-शी)
A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
(-शा)
A Rākṣasī or female goblin.
E.
भू earth, and केश hair.

m. (-क्षित्-क्षिट्)
A hog.
E.
भू the earth, क्षि to destroy, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् added.
